# OpsOh

OpsOh is an independent app studio creating focused apps and games built with purpose, polish, and privacy.

## Main sections
- Apps: https://opsoh.com/apps/
- Games: https://opsoh.com/games/
- Bundles: https://opsoh.com/bundles/
- Guides: https://opsoh.com/guides/
- Videos: https://opsoh.com/videos/
- Studio: https://opsoh.com/studio/
- Support: https://opsoh.com/support/

## Catalog
OpsOh has 60+ apps and a growing collection of games. The catalog is primarily on the App Store, with selected apps also available on Google Play.
Full App Store developer page: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/opsoh-llc/id1877414741
Google Play developer page: https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=6462121865377905232

## Featured apps
- Export Health: Export selected Apple Health records to CSV or create readable PDF summaries. https://opsoh.com/apps/export-health/
- Export Calendar: Export calendar events to CSV or ICS on iPhone and Android. https://opsoh.com/apps/export-calendar/
  Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.opsoh.exportcalendar
- Rename Photos: Batch rename iPhone photos. https://opsoh.com/apps/rename-photos/
- File Cleaner: Find large files and clean iPhone storage. https://opsoh.com/apps/file-cleaner/
- Date Stamp Photos: Add date stamps to photos on iPhone. https://opsoh.com/apps/date-stamp-photos/

## Games
- Wordgrove: Word Search Puzzles
- Skytangle: Star Puzzle
- Brick Breaker – Retro Arcade
Games page: https://opsoh.com/games/
